answer: Assign every reviewer by verifiable randomness drawn only after answers are sealed, so a sybil farm cannot steer its own clones onto the panel judging them. Picture an orchard of ten thousand graders: a ring owning fifty trees has a crystal-clear, tiny chance of landing a majority on any panel, and each misaligned vote it casts gets audited and slashed. Every fake identity becomes a costly voyage with near-zero expected payoff.
